name: Avoice
long_description:
Avoice is an all-in-one, AI-native platform for running an architecture practice. It covers the whole arc of a project: pricing and proposals to win the work, research and schedules in early design, specifications and QA/QC checks through documentation, contract particulars and preliminaries at tender, then RFIs, submittals, instructions, certificates and valuations through construction, and the compliance record at handover. Timesheets, fees, financials and invoicing run alongside, with Xero and QuickBooks.

Specification is the most-used part of the platform. Avoice drafts coordinated, tender-ready specifications from a practice's own drawings, schedules and office masters, then checks them back against those drawings. Work that normally takes weeks takes an afternoon.

Practices in the UK, US, Australia and New Zealand use Avoice, from boutique studios to firms of several hundred people. It integrates with Revit and ArchiCAD.

launches.title: Avoice: Harvey for Architecture
launches.tagline: AI Agents for the $300B Architecture Industry
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [Avoice](https://avoice.co/) is building the AI operating system for architecture. Architects sit at the center of a $300B industry with 3.5M professionals globally, yet their core workflows remain largely untouched by AI. We're building the AI-native workspace that automates documentation, specifications, and coordination across the architecture workflow.\
\
\*\*Launch Video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0C4puetlV8>\*\*\
\
**The Problem**\
\
Architecture sits at the center $12T construction ecosystem. Yet the workflows that run architectural projects — specifications, documentation, coordination, and compliance — are still largely manual.

Architects spend huge amounts of time writing specs, organizing project documentation, coordinating materials, and checking drawings across fragmented tools.

Despite the scale of the industry, there are virtually no AI-native solutions built specifically for architectural workflows.\
\
**The Solution**

**Avoice is building AI operating system for architecture.**

Our AI agents automate the operational workflows that run architectural projects — generating specifications, structuring project documentation, coordinating materials, and managing schedules.

Instead of manually assembling documentation across multiple systems, architects can run these workflows through Avoice turning weeks of works into minutes.

Today firms are already using Avoice to run real projects.

Over $300M in construction projects are currently operating on the platform across firms in 5 countries.\
\
**Team**\
\
[Chawin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chawinasava/) previously served as Co-CEO of Dyno, a 200+ person coatings company where he reversed a decade of decline and grew revenue to $15M while building the company’s architecture sales team and working closely with architects, essentially working with architects every day for two years! Earlier, he founded and sold an edtech startup that scaled to $1M ARR and in high school he co-founded Yindii, a surplus food marketplace now serving 700K+ users across four countries. B.S. in MS&E from Stanford. \
\
[Chawit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chawit-asavasaetakul-a487a724b/) conducted AI research at UCSF and UC Berkeley’s CAHL Lab. He previously built production systems at Amazon powering Alexa+. He is also a U.S. National Chess Master and has ranked among the top 10 players in Thailand for the past five years and counting. CS dropout at UC Berkeley.\
\
Learn more at [avoice.co](https://avoice.co/) and reach out at [founders@avoice.co](mailto:founders@avoice.co)

launches.title: Avoice: The AI workspace for architects
launches.body:
[Avoice](https://www.avoice.co/) is the AI workspace for architecture firms, using AI agents to automate the operational work that takes time away from design. The platform understands messy project data - specifications, schedules, codes, drawings, materials, and notes - and turns them into structured, usable outputs across documentation, coordination, QA/QC, and research.

Instead of architects manually stitching together PDFs, spreadsheets, and folders, Avoice’s AI agents act as digital teammates that can write specifications, check compliance, coordinate schedules, and surface project knowledge across a firm’s past work.

Firms using Avoice already manage $300M+ in active projects on the platform.

**Problem**

Architects spend an enormous amount of time on work that is critical but painful: writing specifications, coordinating schedules, checking codes, redlining documents, and keeping project knowledge consistent across teams.

This work is:

* Fragmented across PDFs, spreadsheets, emails, and folders
* Largely manual, repetitive, and error-prone
* Poorly supported by modern tools (most software optimizes drawings, not documentation)

The architecture industry is also a massive ($300B+) but historically underserved market: highly fragmented, dominated by small and mid-sized firms, and reliant on legacy software built decades ago.

Most incumbents focus on drawings or rigid document systems that require heavy customization and consulting to work for each firm. As a result, many architecture practices still rely on patchworks of spreadsheets, PDFs, and disconnected tools to manage documentation and project knowledge.

As a result, firms lose time, consistency, and institutional knowledge across projects , especially as teams scale or turn over.

**Approach**

We built Avoice around how documentation is actually produced inside architecture firms — specs, schedules, coordination, and QA — not just drawings.

Avoice acts as a shared workspace where project information lives in one place and stays connected as it evolves. Instead of rewriting the same information across different documents, teams can reuse, reference, and update it consistently.

Historically, architecture software struggled because every firm works slightly differently. Customizing workflows and documentation systems for each practice required expensive consulting and was difficult to scale. AI changes this equation.

With Avoice, AI agents can adapt to a firm’s specific standards, templates, and workflows, helping generate specifications, coordinate schedules, check for coordination issues, and support QA while still keeping architects in control of decisions and design intent.
